ahriListing.limitations: Reference record only: identifies the AHRI artifact and states the propositions TA-14 relies on (listed designations; present status Discontinued, dated 2024-12-30, per the certificate's status fields and its definition of Discontinued). Ratings and other certificate content are not reproduced; the certificate's terms restrict entry of its contents into a database, and the ratings are not NIRET criteria. Discontinued models are not AHRI certified (AHRI General OM May 2025 §11.4.3): historical listed identity only. The designations are not complete nameplate model numbers; no nameplate mapping is established. What realizes '+TDR' is not established. Establishes no charging, airflow, static-pressure, run-time, measurement-location or indication criterion, no field condition, and no execution or refrigerant-handling authority.
